digital_edition_evidence.publication_citation: 张光年：《无产阶级的天才歌手——在〈国际歌〉作词者鲍狄埃逝世七十五周年、作曲者狄盖特逝世三十周年纪念大会上的报告》，《人民日报》，1962年12月1日，第5版。
digital_edition_evidence.author_as_displayed: 中国作家协会书记处书记 张光年
digital_edition_evidence.target_locator: Report third text column, upper part, paragraph beginning 列宁曾经给予《国际歌》以崇高评价
digital_edition_evidence.claim_sentence_reading: 早在1900年，列宁创办的《火星报》创刊号上，曾选取《国际歌》六段歌词中最有普遍意义、最为激动人心的三段词，把它介绍给俄国无产者；这三段词因此得到更广泛的流传。
digital_edition_evidence.reading_basis: Manual reading of rendered digital text; remove line wraps and glyph spacing, retain readable punctuation. Not a transcription of original printed glyphs.
digital_edition_evidence.review_scope: Six-page structure inspected; pages 1 and 5 visually reviewed, with close checks of masthead/date, page-5 title/byline/date and target three-stanza sentence. Not a word-by-word collation of the full report or whole newspaper.
digital_edition_evidence.text_representation: Rendered target sentence is PDF text; page-5 rasters are a photograph and narrow graphic elements, not a full-page historical text scan.
digital_edition_evidence.text_extraction_basis: All three page-5 Type0 subset fonts lack ToUnicode; pypdf extraction is visibly garbled. Extracted character codes not used as wording evidence.
digital_edition_evidence.web_comparison_scope: Target claim agrees with the previously checked web transcription in substance; full-report collation and source independence not established.

claim_history_evidence.observation: Distinguishes 1900 French refrain with Russian gloss from 1902 Russian stanzas 1,2,6. Secondary history, not a substitute for the original newspaper.
